name: ESP32-2432S028R "Cheap Yellow Display", ST7789 version
description: The CYD with an ST7789 screen (often the one with two USB ports, though some have one): 2.8" 240x320 ST7789 with XPT2046 resistive touch on a second SPI bus. Same pins as the original CYD.
verify: Colour order BGR and inversion off are the CYD community's setup for the two-USB board's ST7789 (witnessmenow/ESP32-Cheap-Yellow-Display, CYD2USB) and Guition's own for their ST7789 boards, not seen on the glass here. The two-USB board also ships with an ILI9341: if this preset gives a plain white screen, the panel is an ILI9341 being sent an ST7789's start-up - use the "two USB ports, ILI9341" preset. If the picture is a negative, turn Invert on; if red and blue are swapped, set RGB; if touches land mirrored, the touch calibration on first start puts it right.
